exact_result: Unverified proof draft: automatic forward ascent (and actual reverse descent) of the ordinary CLD zero-Hessian equation under every finite separable extension, for every continuous finite multiplier on good separated strict boundaryless pure analytic curves, including singular and nonreduced curves. This includes cyclic cubic extensions such as the degree-three unramified extension of Q2.
concrete_gaps: No proof of finite cubic or general finite-Galois ascent for ordinary (n-1,n-1) forms in dimensions n >= 2: orbital differential terms are not reconstructed.
No current ascent to completed infinite algebraic, inseparable, or transcendental extensions.
No two-sign positive-current regularization or universal classical curve-probe bridge.
No recognition theorem for arbitrary good separated strict boundaryless analytic germs; original P06.2 remains open in its full scope.
The claimed curve theorem is a fallible author draft with no independent or formal verification; finite diagnostics and successful typesetting are not proof verification.
